title: The normalized comparison commutes with the canonical pullback cohomology maps
statement: Let X and Y be quasi-compact separated schemes and F and G quasi-coherent modules [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose cX and cY are families from module cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology] to cohomology of the lifted associated etale sheaves [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention], whose transports through moduleAbelianCohomologyLarge are IsNormalizedCoherentEtaleComparison [def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison]. For g:Y to X and psi:g*F to G [def-pc-module-pullback], there exists a coefficient sheaf morphism theta whose value on ULift.up s is ULift.up of the structural qcoherentPullbackSection formula [lem-weil-pbc-qcoherent-pullback-sections-map]. The inverse cY, after the etale cohomology pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] and the cohomology map of the adjoint of theta, equals the module cohomology map [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] of the tensor-adjoint of psi, after the inverse cX. The assertion assumes the normalized comparisons; it supplies the structural coefficient morphism and the pullback square, but does not assert comparison existence, a simultaneous family over all schemes, or scalar compatibility.

proof.text: For each etale U over X, form the structural section map to its base change over Y, followed by psi. Unit naturality, associativity of adjunction-mate composition, and coefficient naturality show compatibility with restrictions. Apply coefficient lift to construct theta, with the stated component formula.
Refine the inverse image of a finite affine cover of X by a finite affine cover of Y. Do not assume inverse images are affine. Tuple intersections in both covers are affine by separatedness.
The original affine vanishing and normalized-edge results make the two ordinary and lifted etale Cech edges invertible.

The constructed theta has exactly the structural pullback and coefficient formula. On tuple sections ULift.down commutes with that formula. The ringed-site refinement squares therefore identify the two normalized Cech cohomology maps. The abelian refinement square uses exact etale inverse image and gives cohomologyMap followed by the adjoint of theta; the module square gives moduleCohomologyFMap of the tensor adjoint.

Normalized Cech comparisons and cX,cY have the same section and connecting-map normalizations, so effaceable delta-functor uniqueness identifies them. Apply the common-resolution normalization and cancel the invertible edges to obtain the claimed equality. The same zero-complex argument includes empty schemes and zero coefficients.

theorem qcoherentNormalizedComparison_pullback_square
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [Scheme.IsSeparated X]
    [CompactSpace Y] [Scheme.IsSeparated Y]
    (cX : ∀ (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ),
      ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj F) ≃+
        Sheaf.H (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F) q)
    (cY : ∀ (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ),
      ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q).obj G) ≃+
        Sheaf.H (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf G) q)
    (hcX : IsNormalizedCoherentEtaleComparison X
      (fun F _ q ↦ (moduleAbelianCohomologyLarge X F q).symm.trans (cX F q)))
    (hcY : IsNormalizedCoherentEtaleComparison Y
      (fun G _ q ↦ (moduleAbelianCohomologyLarge Y G q).symm.trans (cY G q)))
    (g : Y ⟶ X) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent] (ψ : (tensorPullback g).obj F ⟶ G) :
    ∃ θ : liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F ⟶
        (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf G),
      (∀ (U : X.Etale) (s : (etaleTensorSectionsSheaf F).obj.obj (op U)),
        θ.hom.app (op U) (ULift.up s) = ULift.up
          (qcoherentPullbackSection g F G ψ U
            ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ⊤ g).obj U)
            (pullback.fst U.hom g) pullback.condition s)) ∧
      ∀ (q : ℕ) (x : Sheaf.H (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F) q),
        (cY G q).symm (Sheaf.H.map
          ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).homEquiv
            (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F) (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf G) |>.symm θ)
          q (Etale.cohomologyMap g (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F) q x)) =
        moduleCohomologyFMap g
          ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).homEquiv F G ψ)
          q ((cX F q).symm x)
